author: Jayor320
quote: It is genuinely insulting to the lifelong fanbase to take a game about crime that never cared about who it offended and turn it into a life simulator that has you painting walls and rearranging furniture. You cant steal your neighbours cars, you cant shoot certain **** GRAND THEFT AUTO. The writers did an appalling job, the story is incredibly boring and weak It truly is one of the most disappointing games ever from my favourite franchise. I was already losing interest in the first hour but pushed through hoping for more only to get more and more irritated by it. Rockstar should be ashamed. I have requested a refund, which I have never done for a game purchase before.
